title: psephellus hymenolepis
intro: Psephellus hymenolepis, commonly known as False Cornflower, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Psephellus hymenolepis involve soothing and calming effects on the skin, making it useful in the treatment of skin conditions such as eczema and dermatitis. Research has identified the bioactive constituents of the plant, including flavonoids and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
